info.prompt: A cyber-gothic rhythm game interface pulses with neon cyan and electric magenta against a void black backdrop, skeletal gold filigree framing the screen like a cathedral’s ribcage. Translucent crystalline dice glow with inner fire, their facets refracting synaptic circuitry that weaves across the board in a neural lattice, while an oscilloscope heartbeat thrums at 120 BPM, triggering a 15-second Combo Frenzy that floods the screen with saturated visual juice—terminal text scrolls beneath like a hacker’s live feed.
